captions.detailed: A cinema prime lens featuring a thick, matte black alloy barrel structure. It is composed of a wide manual focus ring at the front, an iris aperture ring around the middle section, and a silver-colored PL bayonet mount plate at the rear base. The focus and aperture rings are designed to rotate independently on continuous revolute joints relative to the central lens barrel.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cinema prime lens with a wide-diameter matte black alloy barrel. It should feature a revolving manual focus ring at the front, a revolving iris aperture ring at the mid-section, and a silver PL bayonet mount plate at the rear.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining three main coaxial parts: the base barrel, the focus ring, and the aperture ring. The base barrel is made from a series of concentric cylinders and hollowed shapes, completed by a silver-colored cylinder for the rear PL mount. The focus ring and aperture rings are modeled as larger-diameter outer cylinders with hollow centers, positioned coaxially along the main barrel axis. Finally, continuous revolute articulations are defined to link the focus ring and the aperture ring to the main base barrel.
